uncited: Unlike its siblings, it explicitly preserves directional visibility information during mipmap generation to mitigate artifacts inherent in standard isotropic pre-integration [Voxel Cone Tracing Anisotropic Filtering](2552-voxel-cone-tracing-anisotropic-filtering.md).

This representation prevents color mixing and opacity under-estimation during MIP-mapping by integrating values along specific axes, allowing for accurate interpolation of lighting at render time [Anisotropic Voxel Representation](4963-anisotropic-voxel-representation.md).
This involves compositing the 8 child voxels front-to-back along the specific axis [Voxel Cone Tracing Anisotropic Filtering](2552-voxel-cone-tracing-anisotropic-filtering.md).
Leaf nodes store only the standard single value [Anisotropic Voxel Representation](4963-anisotropic-voxel-representation.md).
Storing directional values for all properties increases memory consumption by 1.5x compared to isotropic [Voxel Cone Tracing Anisotropic Filtering](2552-voxel-cone-tracing-anisotropic-filtering.md).

The base level of the mipmap is identical for all directions and can be shared, reducing the cost from 6x to 1.5x [Voxel Cone Tracing Anisotropic Filtering](2552-voxel-cone-tracing-anisotropic-filtering.md).
